$comment: NETRA — Zoho Catalyst project manifest. Run `catalyst init` on your machine to bind this to YOUR Catalyst project (it will inject your projectId/environment). The components below map to the platform services NETRA uses. See DEPLOY.md.

appsail.$comment: The Next.js app runs on AppSail (managed Node runtime).

functions.$comment: Serverless functions. ai_quickml proxies the production LLM (Catalyst QuickML) so the frontend never talks to a model directly.

services.data_store: Primary relational store (mirrors the SQLite schema in src/lib/schema.sql)
services.stratus: Object storage for evidence files / exported PDFs
services.quickml: LLM serving (VL-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) + RAG + embeddings — the only AI backend
services.zia: OCR / Speech-to-Text / Translation (Kannada) via Zia Services
services.api_gateway: Routing, throttling and auth in front of Functions
